summary.intent: Run mutation testing on the callisto-model crate's F2 (pending release) graph files and close coverage gaps that surviving mutants reveal.
summary.outcome: A background mutants run failed with exit code 2 and reported one missed mutant: PendingRelease::packages() had no test. A test was added to release_pr.rs and committed, and mutants was re-run on decision.rs and release_pr.rs; the result of that re-run is not shown.

repo: Work for this task happens in a git worktree at .claude/worktrees/wp-f2-pending-release inside the callisto project.

Mutation testing is run through a helper script (~/.claude/jobs/b38d2eaf/tmp/mutants.sh) taking a crate name and a list of source files; logs are written to a wp-f2-pending-release-mutants.log file in the same tmp directory.
Commit messages follow conventional-commit style, e.g. 'test(model): ...'.

code.finding: PendingRelease::packages() was a surviving mutant because no test covered it; a test asserting that a pending release keeps its packages was added (exact lines not given in the transcript).

workflow: Mutation testing surfaces untested accessors that line coverage can miss.
Commit the fix and re-run mutants in a single chained command to verify the gap is closed.
The mutants script exited with code 2, which may reflect missed mutants rather than a tooling failure; check the output and log tail to tell which.

friction: The background mutants job reported 'failed' (exit code 2), so the output file and log had to be read to determine that it meant a missed mutant rather than a crash.
`git add -A` stages everything in the worktree, which risks committing unrelated changes.
open_items: Confirm the re-run of mutants on decision.rs and release_pr.rs finishes with no surviving mutants.
Mutation-test the rest of F2's graph files; the assistant said it would do this next.
